title: Timeline: add/delete/reorder layers, layer properties
description: Timeline layer management is incomplete: (1) + button to add a new normal layer above the active layer (currently may exist but verify it calls addLayer correctly); (2) − button to delete the active layer (with confirmation if it has content); (3) Drag layer rows to reorder; (4) Double-click layer name to rename inline; (5) Layer type UI: right-click or icon to convert between Normal/Guide/Mask; (6) Layer height resize (drag row border); (7) Add Layer Folder button. Wire all to pushDoc mutations on the FlashDocument. The Timeline.tsx already has layer row UI but most mutations call stubs. See docs/02-timeline-animation.md.
